DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園の活動で何をお調べですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What are you checking about park activities?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日曜の清掃に参加したいですが、掲示の雨天欄が剥がれています。雨の日の連絡方法を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃参加希望だが雨天欄が剥がれており、連絡方法を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to join Sunday's cleanup, but the rain-information section of the notice has peeled off. I want to check how to contact someone on a rainy day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to join the cleanup but the rain section is damaged, and want to check the contact method. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 主催者へ確認した案内がこちらにあります。開始は日曜九時です。雨でも必ず実施とは書かれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here is information confirmed with the organizer. It starts Sunday at nine. It does not say it will definitely go ahead in rain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 九時の集合は読めましたが、雨でも行くべきだとは決められなかったので聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 九時集合は読めたが雨でも行くべきか判断できず来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I could read the nine o'clock meeting time but could not decide whether I should come even in rain, so I came to ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you could read the nine o'clock meeting time but came because you could not judge whether to come in rain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実施の判断は主催者です。当日の朝、案内にある電話で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The organizer decides whether it goes ahead. You can call the number in the guide on that morning to check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 雨なら自分で中止と決めず、その番号で確認します。参加申込みはまだ必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 雨天は自分で中止と決めず主催者へ電話し、申込みの必要も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will check that number rather than decide myself that rain means cancellation. Do I still need to apply to attend?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will phone the organizer rather than assume rain cancels it, and ask whether an application is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この回は事前に名前と連絡先を主催者へ伝える案内です。管理受付で申込みを代行はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: For this event, the instructions say to give your name and contact details to the organizer in advance. Management reception does not apply on your behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では主催者へ自分で連絡します。ここで質問しただけでは申込み済みではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 主催者へ自ら連絡し、管理受付で質問しただけでは申込完了でないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will contact the organizer myself. Asking here alone does not mean I have applied, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will contact the organizer yourself and confirm that asking management reception does not complete an application. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、参加受付とは別です。剥がれた掲示は管理側で直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct, this is separate from participant registration. Management will repair the peeling notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 主催者に参加希望を伝え、雨天時は朝に実施を確認します。読めない掲示だけで判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加希望と雨天実施を主催者へ確認し、読めない掲示だけで決めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell the organizer I want to join and check on the morning whether it runs in rain. I will not decide based only on the unreadable notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm attendance and rain arrangements with the organizer rather than decide from the unreadable notice alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。掲示の不具合も知らせていただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for also reporting the damaged notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。切符の購入でお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I help you buy a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 行き先を選びましたが、友人から別の駅へ来てほしいと連絡が来ました。支払う前に直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人から目的駅変更の連絡があり、支払前に選択を直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I selected a destination, but my friend asked me to come to a different station. I want to correct it before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your friend changed the destination station and you want to correct the selection before payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお金を入れたり、カードで支払ったりしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you not inserted money or paid by card yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。画面で行き先を選んだだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現金もカードも未払いで、行先選択だけだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Neither. I only selected the destination on the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have paid neither cash nor card and only selected a destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、この戻るボタンで選択をやり直せます。新しい行き先を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then you can start selection again with this back button. Please show me the new destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このメッセージの駅です。前の駅まで買って、後で直すより、今ここで選び直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新しい駅のメッセージを示し、旧駅の券を買う前に選び直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The station in this message. I want to select it again now instead of buying the old destination and changing it later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the message with the new station and say you want to reselect before buying the old station's ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが新しい駅の選択です。画面の行き先と表示金額をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the new station selection. Please check the destination and displayed price.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駅名は合っています。二人分になっているので、一人分に戻していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅名は一致するが二人分になっており、一人分へ訂正を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The station name is right. It is set for two people, so could you change it back to one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the station name but ask to correct two people to one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一人分に変更しました。まだ購入は確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I changed it to one. The purchase is not finalized yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 行き先と一人分の金額を確認しました。ここから支払って購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行先と一人分の金額を確認して購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the destination and price for one person. I will pay and buy it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you checked the destination and one-person price and will purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、支払後は切符の行き先もご確認ください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, check the destination on the ticket after paying too. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。相談の予約について何をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like about a consultation booking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの預け先と、ごみの出し方を相談したいです。同じ予約で両方聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保育とごみの相談を同じ予約で聞けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want advice about childcare and rubbish disposal. Can I ask both in the same appointment?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether childcare and rubbish advice can be given in the same appointment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当が異なります。保育の相談は予約、ごみの案内は別の窓口でお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Different staff handle them. Childcare requires a consultation booking, while rubbish guidance is available at another desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つとも保育の窓口で答えてもらえるとは思わないほうがよいんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保育窓口だけで二つを回答してもらえるわけではないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should not assume the childcare desk can answer both questions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that the childcare desk alone cannot necessarily answer both matters. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。まず保育の相談日時を確認しましょう。来られる時間帯はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. Let us first check a childcare consultation time. When can you come?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金曜の午前なら行けます。子どもの年齢と、預けたい時間をメモして持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金曜午前を希望し、子どもの年齢と希望時間をメモする予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Friday morning works. I will bring notes with my child's age and the hours I want childcare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request Friday morning and say you plan to note your child's age and desired hours. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 金曜十時の相談枠が空いています。ごみの案内は今日でも受け取れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a Friday ten o'clock slot. You can collect rubbish guidance today too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 保育は金曜十時で予約したいです。ごみの案内は今日、別の窓口で受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保育相談は金曜十時を予約し、ごみ案内は今日別窓口で受け取ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to book childcare advice Friday at ten. I will collect rubbish guidance today at the separate desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Book childcare advice Friday at ten and say you will get rubbish guidance today at another desk. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容で記録しました。保育の申込み自体が完了したわけではなく、相談の予約です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I recorded that. This is a consultation booking, not a completed childcare application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相談予約と申込みは別ですね。金曜に条件を聞き、ごみの案内は今日の窓口で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談予約と保育申込みは別と理解し、二つの案内を分けて確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: A consultation booking and application are separate, then. I will ask about conditions Friday and check rubbish guidance at today's desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you understand consultation booking and childcare application differ and will check the two services separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの案内先をお渡しします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will give you the two contact points. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受診の書類で何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your medical documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場に領収書を出すよう言われました。原本を手元に残したいので、コピーでよいか先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 職場へ領収書を提出するが原本を残したいため、コピー可否を先に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Work told me to submit a receipt. I want to keep the original, so I want to check first whether a copy is acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you will submit a receipt to work but want to keep the original, so you want to check whether a copy is accepted first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先がコピーを受け付けるかは、職場への確認になります。診断書も求められていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your workplace must confirm whether they accept copies. Have they requested a medical certificate too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は領収書とだけ言われています。診断内容を書き足してほしいという依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 職場の指定は領収書だけで、診断内容の追加依頼ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: At present they only said receipt. They have not asked for diagnostic details to be added.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that work specified only a receipt, not adding diagnostic information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日の領収書はこの原本です。お名前と日付をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. This is today's original receipt. Please check your name and date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前も今日の日付も合っています。職場へ見せる前に、自分で保管する控えを作りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前と日付を確認し、自分用の控えを先に作りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Both my name and today's date match. I want to make a copy to keep before showing it to work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the name and date and say you want to make your own copy first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 控えを作ることはできますが、原本提出が必要かどうかは別にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can make a copy, but please separately check whether the original must be submitted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 職場に原本かコピーかを聞きます。コピーでよければ原本は自宅に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 職場に原本かコピーか確認し、コピー可なら原本を自宅保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask work whether they need the original or a copy. If a copy is fine, I will keep the original at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask work about original versus copy and keep the original at home if copies are accepted. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の書類が必要とわかった場合は、求められた書類名で改めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you learn another document is required, consult us again using the name of that document.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 領収書を勝手に診断書として出さず、提出条件を確認します。今日は原本を大切に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 領収書を診断書扱いせず提出条件を確認し、今日は原本を持帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not submit the receipt as though it were a medical certificate; I will check submission conditions. Today I will carefully take the original home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not treat the receipt as a medical certificate, will check submission conditions, and take the original home today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お大事になさってください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなご用件ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What brings you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日届け出た財布が家で見つかりました。見つかったことを同じ届出に伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前日の届出の財布が自宅で見つかったので同じ届出へ報告したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The wallet I reported yesterday was found at home. I want to report its recovery under the same case.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that yesterday's reported wallet was found at home and you want to update that same report. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 届出の控えをお願いします。どこで見つかりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I have the report receipt? Where was it found?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号です。今朝、家の上着の内ポケットで見つけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控え番号を示し、今朝上着の内ポケットで発見したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This number. I found it this morning in an inner pocket of a jacket at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the reference number and explain you found it this morning in a jacket's inner pocket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 財布の特徴や中の物は、ご自身の届出と一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do the wallet features and contents match your report?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 黒い二つ折りで、自分の名前のカードがあります。中身も確認しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黒い二つ折りと本人名カードがあり、中身も確認済みだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is a black bifold and has a card with my name. I checked the contents too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that it is a black bifold with a card in your name and you checked the contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発見の連絡を記録します。カードの発行元にも紛失の連絡をしていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record the recovery. Had you also reported the loss to the card issuer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、銀行へ停止をお願いしました。ここで発見を伝えただけで、カードも使えるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 銀行へ停止連絡済みで、警察への発見報告だけで利用再開とは思わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I asked the bank to block it. I do not assume reporting recovery here means I can use the card again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you asked the bank to block the card and do not assume reporting recovery to police restarts its use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 銀行のカードの状態は、発行元へ別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the bank card's status separately with its issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 財布の発見をこの届出に記録してもらい、銀行には停止後の扱いを別に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見記録を依頼し、カード停止後の扱いは銀行へ別に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please record the wallet's recovery in this report. I will separately ask the bank what happens after the block.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request the recovery record and say you will separately ask the bank about the blocked card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発見の連絡を受け付けました。ご連絡ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We accepted the recovery report. Thank you for contacting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。不在票について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your missed-delivery notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ドアに不在票が入っていましたが、私の部屋番号と違います。再配達を頼む前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票の部屋番号が違うため再配達依頼前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: A notice was left at my door, but the room number differs from mine. I want to check before requesting redelivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the notice's room number differs and you want to check before requesting redelivery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 票の番号と、記載された部屋番号をご覧いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you check the notice number and the room number written on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 票は三〇一ですが、私は三〇二です。宛名も私や家族の名前ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 票は三〇一、自室は三〇二で宛名も家族ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The notice says 301, but I am in 302. The name is neither mine nor a family member's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the notice says 301 while your room is 302 and the addressee is not your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 別のお部屋宛ての票のようですね。すでに再配達を申し込みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It seems addressed to another room. Have you already requested redelivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。隣の方の都合を知らないので、私の受け取れる時刻で申し込まないようにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 再配達は未申込で、隣人の都合が不明なので自分の都合で頼まなかったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I do not know my neighbor's availability, so I did not request it at a time convenient for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not requested redelivery because you do not know your neighbor's availability and did not choose your own convenient time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この票は配達担当に確認します。隣の方の荷物を代わりに受け取りたいというご相談ではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check this notice with delivery staff. You are not asking to receive the neighbor's parcel on their behalf, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、代わりに受け取りません。違う部屋に票が入っていたことをお知らせしたいだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 代理受取りではなく誤った投函の連絡のみだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Correct, I will not receive it for them. I only want to report that the notice was left at the wrong room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that this is only reporting a wrongly delivered notice, not receiving on their behalf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。番号と配達先を照会し、担当へ票を戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will check the reference and delivery address and return the notice to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この票を預けます。自分の荷物だと思って保管期限までの受取りを決めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 票を預け、自分の荷物と考えて受取り予定を決めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand this notice over. I will not treat it as my parcel and decide when to collect it before the storage deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand over the notice and not plan collection on the assumption it is your parcel. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご連絡ありがとうございます。配達担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for contacting us. We will tell delivery staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。カードについて何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 再発行を申し込んだ控えに、以前の実家の住所があります。新しいカードの送付先か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再発行控えの旧実家住所がカード送付先なのか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My card-reissue receipt shows my former family-home address. I want to check whether that is where the new card will be sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check whether the old family-home address on the reissue receipt is the card delivery address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の住所とは違うのですね。申込みの受付番号はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: It differs from your current address, then. Do you have the application reference number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この番号です。今はこの市で一人暮らしですが、控えには実家が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付番号を示し、現在はこの市で一人暮らしだが控えは実家だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This number. I now live alone in this city, but the receipt shows my family home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the reference number and explain that you now live alone in this city while the receipt shows your family home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が申込み内容を確認します。表示の住所だけで、実際の発送先だとまだ断定はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check the application. We cannot yet conclude from the displayed address alone that it is the actual delivery destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: わかりました。家族が受け取ればよいと決めず、発送の前に送付先を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族受取りと決めず発送前に送付先を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Rather than decide my family can receive it, I want to check the delivery destination before it is sent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the destination before shipping rather than assume your family can receive it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認したところ、送付先も実家になっていました。まだ発送前なので、変更手続きの担当へおつなぎできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We checked and the delivery destination is also your family home. It has not shipped yet, so we can connect you with staff for an address-change procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の住所へ変更したいです。登録住所と再発行の送付先が両方どうなるか、担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現住所への変更を希望し、登録住所と再発行送付先の両方の扱いを確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to change it to my current address. I will ask staff what happens to both the registered address and the reissue delivery destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a change to the current address and say you will check both the registered address and the reissue destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な確認をしてから変更します。ここでのお申出だけでは、変更完了ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will change it after the necessary checks. Merely requesting it here does not complete the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当の手続きを済ませ、変更結果を確認します。控えに今の住所が反映されたかも見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当手続きと結果を確認し、控えの住所反映も見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will complete the procedure with staff and check the result. I also want to see whether my current address appears on the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the staff procedure and result and want to see the updated address on the receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。発送前の確認として引き継ぎます。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will hand this over as a pre-shipping check. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。商品について何をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about the product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買ったごみ袋の包装が破れていました。まだ使っていないので、対応を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未使用のごみ袋包装が破れていたので対応を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The packaging of the rubbish bags I bought yesterday was torn. I have not used them, so I want to ask what can be done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about torn packaging on unused rubbish bags. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品とレシートを確認します。同じ商品への交換をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the product and receipt. Do you want the same product in exchange?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この二十枚入りと交換したいです。家のごみ箱に合うので、別の大きさにはしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二十枚入りの同商品を希望し、ごみ箱に合うためサイズを変えたくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want this twenty-pack. It fits my bin, so I do not want a different size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request the same twenty-pack and say you do not want another size because it fits your bin. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ商品は今日は欠品です。大きい袋への交換か、今回の購入の返金をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The same product is out of stock today. We can offer larger bags in exchange or refund this purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きい袋では合わないので、返金を希望します。追加で別の商品を買う必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大サイズの交換は受けず返金を希望し、別商品の購入が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The larger ones do not fit, so I want a refund. Do I need to buy something else?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decline the larger exchange, request a refund and ask whether another purchase is necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回は別商品の購入は不要です。購入時の決済方法を確認して返金手続きをします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Another purchase is not necessary this time. We will check the original payment method and process the refund.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: このカードで買いました。現金で受け取れると決めず、返金方法を説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入カードを示し、現金返金と決めず方法の説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I bought it with this card. Please explain the refund method rather than assume I can receive cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the purchase card and ask for the refund method without assuming a cash refund. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回はカード決済の取消しで返金します。控えをお渡しするので、反映は後でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: This refund will be a cancellation of the card payment. We will give you a receipt, so check later when it is reflected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: カード決済の取消しですね。今日は現金を受け取らず、控えを残して後で反映を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カード取消しで現金受取りではないと理解し、控えで後日反映を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: A card-payment cancellation, then. I will not receive cash today; I will keep the receipt and check the adjustment later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that it is a card cancellation, not cash, and say you will keep the receipt and check the adjustment later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。手続きの控えをお渡しします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here is the procedure receipt. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。散歩のことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 犬を連れて来ました。遊具の近くに入れないという表示を、地図でも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬連れで入れない遊具周辺の範囲を地図で確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought my dog. I want to check on the map the area near the play equipment where dogs are not allowed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check on the map the play-equipment area you cannot enter with a dog. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この公園では、地図の黄色い遊具区域が犬連れで入れない範囲です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this park, dogs are not allowed in the yellow play area on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 黄色の中ですね。家族がそこで遊びますが、私は犬と外側を歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 黄色区域を理解し、家族はそこで遊ぶが自分は犬と外側を歩くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Inside the yellow area, then. My family will play there, but I want to walk outside it with the dog.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you understand the yellow area and your family will play there while you walk outside with your dog. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外側の青い道は利用できます。遊具区域を横切る近道は使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use the blue path outside. Do not take the shortcut across the play area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い道を回ります。家族とは、黄色の外にある入口で合流できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青い道を使い、区域外の入口で家族と合流できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will go around on the blue path. Can I meet my family at the entrance outside the yellow area?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will use the blue path and ask whether you may meet your family at the entrance outside the area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その入口は区域の外です。待つ時は通路をふさがないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That entrance is outside the area. Please do not block the path while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 入口で待ちます。犬はつないだままにし、家族を探しに遊具区域へ入らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口で待ち、犬をつないで区域内へ家族を探しに行かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait at the entrance. I will keep the dog on a lead and not enter the play area looking for my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait at the entrance with the dog on a lead and not go into the area to look for family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 地図に区域と合流場所を印しました。ご家族にも場所を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I marked the area and meeting point on the map. Please tell your family the place too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族に印の入口を伝えました。私は犬と青い道だけ歩き、そこへ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流入口を家族に伝え、犬と青い道を歩いて入口へ戻ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I told my family the marked entrance. I will walk only the blue path with my dog and return there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you told your family the meeting entrance and will walk the blue path with the dog and return there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご協力ありがとうございます。散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for your cooperation. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help do you need today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰りの切符を買いたいです。途中の駅で友人を乗せて、一緒に帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 途中の駅で友人と合流して帰るため帰りの切符を買いたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to buy a ticket home. My friend will board at an intermediate station and we will return together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to buy a return-journey ticket because you will meet your friend at an intermediate station and go home together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様はここから、友人の方は途中からですね。お二人の降りる駅は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You board here, and your friend partway along. Will you both get off at the same station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。同じ駅です。私が往復券を買えば、帰りに友人も使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ降車駅であり往復券を二人で使えると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the same station. I thought if I bought a round-trip ticket my friend could use it on the return too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you share the same destination and thought two people could use one round-trip ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 往復券はお一人の行き帰りの券です。友人の方の乗車分は別に必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: A round-trip ticket covers one person's outward and return journeys. Your friend's ride needs a separate ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、私はここからの片道券にします。友人の切符もここで買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分は片道券を選び友人の乗車区間の券もここで買えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will get a one-way ticket from here. Can I also buy my friend's travel section here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose a one-way ticket for yourself and ask whether you can buy your friend's section here too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その区間の券は当窓口で扱っていません。友人の方が乗る駅で購入していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This counter does not sell that section. Your friend can buy it at the station where they board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に自分の駅で買うよう伝えます。合流する列車を決めてから私の分を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人には乗る駅で購入してもらい合流する列車を先に決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell my friend to buy it at their station. I want to choose the train we will meet on before buying my ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your friend will buy at their boarding station and you will decide the meeting train first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 列車を決めるときは、友人の駅にも停車するか確認してください。到着時刻だけでは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When choosing, check that it stops at your friend's station too. Arrival time alone is not enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停車駅を見て友人と列車を決めます。その後、私一人の片道券をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の駅への停車を確認してから自分一人の片道券を購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the stops and choose the train with my friend. After that, please sell me a one-way ticket for myself alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the train stops at your friend's station before buying your own one-person one-way ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。列車が決まりましたらお声がけください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03203-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Let us know once you have decided the train. Take care.
